integrity: The proof is self-contained. Finite direct descendant checks and a brute-force small-length optimum checker are included as corroboration; no computation is used as a substitute for the all-n argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only binary length-n weight-two codes for exactly one arbitrary deletion; not the unrestricted code optimum or other weights. Historical priority beyond the inspected sources has not been independently established.
title: Exact optimum for binary weight-two single-deletion codes
